rationale: The contract is a narrow label-production replay, not a training launch. v20.88 already supplies four source-safe hard-negative contrast candidates for the same heldout row, and success only needs one informative non-strict/failed contrast label with zero harmful compiled mismatches and preserved leakage constraints. Main risk is adjudication semantics: a Lean failure must become a useful contrast label rather than an unclassified harness failure, and non-strict contrast must not be conflated with harmful compiled mismatch.
